name: Motivated Macro Dolly
summary: Physically plausible forward camera movement used to inspect a small but story-critical surface or mechanism while preserving spatial orientation.

intent.viewerQuestion: What does this part actually look like up close?
intent.desiredPerceptualResult: A detailed, stable close view that increases understanding rather than merely making the scene feel energetic.
avoidWhen: Scene geometry or texture resolution cannot withstand close inspection.
The camera would cross the action axis or hide the important contact point.
A flat 2D label must remain the sole subject of attention.

visibleCues: A foreground subject grows in frame while near and far planes exhibit depth-consistent parallax.
The hero detail stays inside a deliberate safe area.
Motion slows to a readable stable close-up.
plausibleCauses: A physical virtual-camera translation toward a target at approximately fixed focal length.
A mixture of camera translation and small focal-length adjustment.
2.5D depth-layer translation with carefully bounded parallax.
unknowns: Source focal length and camera-to-subject distance cannot generally be recovered uniquely.
A digital crop can mimic enlargement but not correct geometric parallax.

beats.direction: Compose a readable medium-wide view with the intended close-up target visible and correct material scale.
Translate the camera toward the chosen target along a collision-free path, using an authored velocity graph. Maintain target screen location, inspect the silhouette and avoid near clipping.
beats.attentionTarget: Growing region of genuine geometric detail

beats.direction: Reach zero apparent drift and hold the detail; allow lighting gradients and textures to convey shape without extra camera wobble.
beats.attentionTarget: Final surface, joint, or engraved feature

craftNotes: Use camera position + target constraints, not a zoom-only replacement, when real parallax matters.
Inspect near plane, focus distance, shadow map precision and texture texel density at the final dolly position.
Keep target screen-space trajectory smooth and test both landscape and portrait re-composition.
Prefer low angular velocity during close inspection to prevent visual fatigue.
recipe.fallback: Use a shorter forward move ending earlier at a quality-verified distance; add an explicit 2D detail inset if asset geometry cannot pass macro inspection.

parameters.name: forwardTravelFractionOfStartingDistance
parameters.visualImpact: Controls magnification and parallax; requires bounds and clipping preflight.
failureSigns: Camera clips through the model or shallow geometry becomes obvious.

parameters.name: dollyDurationFraction
parameters.visualImpact: Balances sense of investigation with viewer orientation.
failureSigns: Move feels like a sudden digital punch or continues into the next edit.

parameters.name: detailHoldFraction
parameters.visualImpact: Reserves still time for the eye to inspect fine detail.
failureSigns: Image cuts before detail can be understood.

kumiki.adapterNotes: Map to CC1 camera path, existing shot frame clock and collision/visibility checks; validate 2.5D alternative without claiming true 3D parallax.

acceptanceChecks: Near/far planes show consistent geometric parallax during the dolly, or the shot is explicitly labeled a 2.5D alternative.
No near-plane clipping, texture blur, specular aliasing or missing normals in the final hold.
The hero detail remains inside safe framing throughout the shot and both aspect-ratio variants pass review.
